source_snapshot.items: NVQual - Grace RX PCIe EOM Test
source_snapshot.procedure: Measure eye-opening metric on Grace CPU root ports with endpoints.

old_problem: Root-port/endpoint/lane map, EOM fields/units/samples/thresholds and link recovery are missing; Criteria are unrelated.
disposition_reason: Grace RX EOM purpose is explicit; topology, sample configuration and every-lane numeric rule are runtime project/vendor inputs.
decision_basis: Preserved each Grace root-port lane and EOM coverage.

test_case.test_name: Grace RX PCIe per-lane EOM qualification
test_case.purpose: Measure the approved EOM fields for every mapped Grace RX lane and enforce signed per-lane limits.
test_case.test_command: Verify topology/module; isolate affected services; capture baseline link; run approved EOM measurement; retain raw per-lane values, negotiated state, errors and FW/health.
test_case.expected_result: Every required lane reports valid samples meeting signed EOM limits and link returns healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Readable output/FW or aggregate-only result cannot PASS every-lane EOM.
test_case.recovery: Stop on link degradation, restore baseline and verify endpoint/root-port health.

source_conflict.reason: Per-lane EOM oracle controls; readability/FW remain auxiliary.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind module, topology, EOM settings/limits and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; RUNTIME CONFIGURATION REQUIRED; NOT EXECUTED

project_authority: EOM fields and limits are vendor/project-specific.
